# Revora — Service and contact information

Revora offers phone repair and phone buyback services in Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, and Thane, India. The website does not publish a customer-facing street address. Contact the team to confirm whether a service is currently available for your location and device.

## Contact
- Website: https://www.sellrepairphone.org/
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 85917 70877
- Email: support@sellrepairphone.org
- Contact page: https://www.sellrepairphone.org/contact

## Website pages
- Phone repair in Mumbai: https://www.sellrepairphone.org/mobile-repair-mumbai
- Sell a phone: https://www.sellrepairphone.org/sell-phone
- Phone buyback: https://www.sellrepairphone.org/buyback
- Frequently asked questions: https://www.sellrepairphone.org/faq
- Privacy policy: https://www.sellrepairphone.org/privacy-policy
- Terms: https://www.sellrepairphone.org/terms

## Guidance
Service availability and any quote depend on the device, its condition, location, and current operating options. Customers should confirm applicable pricing, timing, payment, parts, warranty, pickup, and data-handling terms with Revora before proceeding. This document does not promise a particular repair outcome, offer, turnaround time, or data sanitization process.
